passage.label: when finished duties stand up worship; Lord direct longing

mainSubject.label: When duties are completed, standing up for worship is commanded and directing one's longing toward the Lord alone

subordinateSubjects.label: When duties are finished, standing up for worship commanded
Longing directed exclusively toward the Lord

commandsAndProhibitions.description: So when you have finished your duties, then stand up for worship.
And to your Lord direct your longing.

humanConditionsAndSpiritualStates.label: Transition from worldly duties to devoted worship as a continuous cycle
Exclusive divine orientation as the culmination of all striving

relationships.label: Worship completion followed by longing redirection forming the closing spiritual instruction

terminology.gloss: stand up for worship after finishing duties (editorial gloss)

notes: Wave 13 genuine re-extraction. Boundaries follow the text: P1 closes with the doubled hardship-ease declaration (5-6) before the post-duty worship command opens (7); P2 covers the two-verse closing instruction on worship completion and divine orientation (7-8).
